## ✨ Highlights

The Controller's pages open read-only, and Janus is rebuilt with Go
1.27.4 on fresh kernels.

- 👁️ **Read-only pages**: a switch beside Refresh hides everything that
  changes a node, a cluster or the Controller - one click to edit, and
  back to read-only by itself after 15 minutes without activity.
- 🔒 **Go 1.27.4** for every Janus binary, **Docker Compose v5.7.1** in
  the Controller's updater (a crash of Go's HTTP/1 server), **Linux
  7.3.4 and 6.18.63**.

## ⚠️ Upgrade notes

- **The pages now open read-only.** Nothing that changes something is
  shown until you switch the header's **Read-only** to **Editing**.
  Rather have them as before? **Settings › Your pages › Pages open:
  read-write** - kept with your account.
- The switch is a convenience of the pages, not a permission: roles,
  grants, API tokens, janusctl and Terraform work as before.

## 🔒 Security

- **Go 1.27.4** (was 1.27.3) for janusd, janusctl, the Controller, its
  updater, the node_exporter extension and the Terraform provider:
  Go's HTTP/1 server could crash on a race between a request body's size
  limit and its headers
  ([CVE-2026-97054](https://pkg.go.dev/vuln/GO-2026-6859),
  [#635](https://github.com/swenske/Janus/pull/635)). Update the nodes,
  the Controller and janusctl.
- **Docker Compose v5.7.0 → v5.7.1** in the Controller's updater, built
  with the fixed Go
  ([#633](https://github.com/swenske/Janus/pull/633)): the updater
  container is updated with the Controller's image.
- **Linux 7.3.3 → 7.3.4** (the default kernel track) and **6.18.62 →
  6.18.63** (nodes pinned to longterm): inet no longer matches an
  unhashed socket in an established lookup
  ([CVE-2026-99288](https://www.cve.org/CVERecord?id=CVE-2026-99288),
  [#632](https://github.com/swenske/Janus/pull/632),
  [#631](https://github.com/swenske/Janus/pull/631)); the other fixes of
  these releases are in code Janus doesn't build.

## 🖥️ Controller

- **A Read-only switch on every page**
  ([#636](https://github.com/swenske/Janus/pull/636), fixes
  [#527](https://github.com/swenske/Janus/issues/527),
  [Read-only pages](https://janus.sw-servers.net/docs/dashboard/README.md#read-only-pages)):
  left of Refresh on the Controller's page and on every node page.
  Read-only hides - doesn't grey out - the actions on nodes (Apply,
  Reload, Restart, Reboot, Upgrade, servers' state...), clusters,
  machines, hypervisors and the Controller's own administration
  (accounts, tokens, backups, fleet, Let's Encrypt, Consul, log
  forwarding, HTTPS certificate, high availability, single sign-on).
  - **Diagnosis stays**: the connectivity test, packet capture, the
    diagnostic bundle, a cluster's **Check now**, and every editor's
    **Validate**/**Check** - you can edit a configuration and check it,
    Apply needs Editing. So do your own password, second factors and
    SSH keys.
  - **Back to read-only after 15 minutes** without activity in edit
    mode (5, 30, 60 or never in Settings › Your pages) - never during a
    confirmation, a trial waiting for its Confirm, an update under way
    or a passphrase shown once; a node page opened from the Controller's
    is in the same mode.
  - An account that can only read has no switch: its pages change
    nothing anyway.
- **Hidden means hidden**: a few buttons a role doesn't reach (a
  service's restart, node_exporter's Save) still showed to readers.

## 📦 Components

- **Linux 7.3.4 and 6.18.63**, their configurations as kbuild resolves
  them (the SATA_INIC162X driver gone from 7.3.4).
